risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (401.76) with flat yield curve and imminent NFP event creates severe macro headwinds; 56-day earnings window provides some buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable for trading AOS.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 50/200 and SMA 50/200 bullish crossovers with supertrend confirmation, plus contrarian fear-zone opportunity at potential support (62.79), offer early momentum setup for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price structure is decisively bearish (below all key moving averages), RSI momentum is weak (<41), MACD is negative, volume is not confirming, macro environment is in crisis (VIX 401.76), and fundamental conviction is absent—confluence is insufficient and risk/reward is unfavorable.
